option.counterfactual: There are projections in a finite AW*-factor whose partial sums are uniformly norm-bounded but whose normalized dimensions do not tend to zero. Thus the bounded-sums dimension lemma used to exclude the proposed sequences is false.
option.approach: Investigate whether a bounded-sums sequence of projections with uniformly positive dimension can be converted into an increasing sequence with exactly constant quasitrace increments. Then examine separately whether that sequence lacks a least upper bound.

options.counterfactual: The quotient of a product of finite AW*-factors by sequences that vanish in quasitrace need not itself be an AW*-factor.
options.approach: Audit the annihilator axiom for the quotient, concentrating on whether supports of individual elements extend to projection-generated annihilators for arbitrary subsets. Identify any additional completeness assumption needed for that extension.

options.counterfactual: The existence of any bounded increasing sequence with a fixed positive quasitrace increment already guarantees, possibly in another finite AW*-factor, a witness with increment exactly 1/2.
options.approach: Study normalization of long finite blocks by their total positive sum, using spectral cutoffs when the sum is not invertible. Seek a lower bound approaching 1/2 for the quasitraces of many normalized increments.
